g.text: Redis interop boundary: the mixed Node + Rust fleet (phases 1–2)
The keyspace is the contract. Both fleets must read and write the same keys, scripts, channels and encodings.
written only through the CAS script
100 entries, 300 s TTL, LPUSH before PUBLISH
tier 2 for anonymous only on WS
grace-eviction ZSET swept by any instance
22 eval sites: Node sends EVAL with the script body;
Rust loads the same Lua (include_str!) and uses EVALSHA + NOSCRIPT reload
Encoding contract (keyspace diff in RB-10 compares both fleets): queue / currentClimbQueueItem are JSON.stringify of client objects (insertion order, undefined dropped);
null item = empty string · nullable scalars → '' · booleans '1' / '0' · epoch-ms strings · UNSET_SENTINEL tri-state in connection / participant hashes.
Every queue delta carries the post-event stateHash / stateHashOrdered (FNV-1a over UUID order, byte-for-byte).
